bookloq_transaction_matches_target_check.name: bookloq_transaction_matches_target_check
bookloq_transaction_matches_target_check.value: (("bookloq_transaction_matches"."supplier_bill_id" is not null) + ("bookloq_transaction_matches"."customer_invoice_id" is not null) + ("bookloq_transaction_matches"."document_id" is not null)) = 1

marketing_email_preferences_recipient_ch.name: marketing_email_preferences_recipient_check
marketing_email_preferences_recipient_ch.value: "marketing_email_preferences"."status" <> 'subscribed' OR ("marketing_email_preferences"."email_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "marketing_email_preferences"."subject_hash" IS NOT NULL)

marketing_resource_selections_scope_chec.name: marketing_resource_selections_scope_check
marketing_resource_selections_scope_chec.value: (("marketing_resource_selections"."scope_kind" = 'organization' and "marketing_resource_selections"."local_location_id" is null) or ("marketing_resource_selections"."scope_kind" = 'location' and "marketing_resource_selections"."local_location_id" is not null))
